answer_1.quote: We found the use of a combined semantic and syntactic, pattern and grammar-based approach sufficient to generate one million Runyankore sentences, both labelled and unlabelled, from a dictionary of terms categorized into their appropriate parts of speech.

answer_2.quote: The four-sentiment model was trained on 800,000 sentences and tested on 200,000 sentences, and achieved 64% accuracy. The binary sentiment model had a dataset with 541,751 examples, and it was trained on 500,000 sentences and tested on 41,751 sentences, and achieved 77.3% accuracy.
